steps.title: Prepare iPSCs for Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for nucleofection by splitting and coating plates.

substeps.instruction: Split cells into 3 wells of a 6-well plate 48 hours prior to nucleofection (aim for confluence in 48 hours; 3 million cells per nucleofection required).
Coat a 6-well plate with 1mL Matrigel (supplemented with RGD fragment) for 1 hour.
Wash each well with 1-2mL PBS.
Add 1mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37°C for 5-10 minutes to achieve single cells.
Collect cells in 5mL DMEM/F12 and transfer to a 15mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 750-800 rpm for 3 minutes.
Resuspend cells in mTesR1 (2mL per well) supplemented with 1uM Rock Inhibitor.
Plate 2mL of cells per well on a Matrigel (supplemented with RGD fragment) coated plate.

steps.title: Prepare Nucleofection Plate and DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the target plate and aliquot the required DNA.

substeps.instruction: Coat 2-3 wells of a plate with Matrigel supplemented with RGD for 1 hour.
Just prior to splitting cells, equilibrate the Matrigel/RGD coated plate with 3-5mL/well DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS supplemented with 10uM Rock Inhibitor.
Aliquot DNA into 1.7mL tubes based on the following: pMaxGFP (1 ug/ul, 1 ul), Cas9 SM168 (3 ug total), and Donor Oligo (100uM, 3 ul).

steps.title: Harvest and Count Cells for Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and calculate the volume needed to reach 3 million cells.

substeps.instruction: Wash wells with 1-2mL PBS.
Add 1mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37°C for 5-10 minutes (check at 5 minutes).
Collect cells in 5mL PBS and transfer to a 15mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 750-800 rpm for 3 minutes.
Resuspend cell pellet in 3mL PBS in a 15mL conical tube.
Pipette 10uL into a Countess slide and calculate the average number of cells using all four corners.
Calculate total cells: (Average number of cells) x 10,000 x 3.
Determine the volume required for 3 million cells: (Total cells / 3,000,000) / 3.

steps.title: Perform Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Combine cells with DNA and the Lonza reaction mix, then nucleofect.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the calculated volume of cells to a microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 90xg for 5 minutes.
Prepare the reaction mix using Lonza Kit: P3 Primary Cell 4D (V4XP-3024), totaling 100ul per nucleofection.
Combine the 100ul Reaction Mix with the aliquoted DNA.
Mix the Reaction Mix + DNA with the cell pellet by pipetting up and down with a p200 pipette (minimal pipetting to avoid damage).
Transfer 100ul to a cuvette.
Use a dropper to add a small amount of media to the cuvette to recover all cells.
Transfer the cells/DNA solution to a pre-coated well containing 2mL of DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS + 10uM Rock Inhibitor.
Incubate at 37°C overnight.

steps.title: Post-Nucleofection Culture
steps.instruction: Maintain iPSCs and adjust Rock Inhibitor concentrations over the first few days.

substeps.instruction: Continue culturing iPSCs in 1 well of a 6-well plate for 5-7 days, changing mTesR1 daily.
At 24 hours post-nucleofection: add mTesR1 with 5uM Rock Inhibitor.
At 48 hours post-nucleofection: add mTesR1 with 2.5uM Rock Inhibitor.
At 72 hours post-nucleofection: add mTesR1 with 1uM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Single Cell Cloning
steps.instruction: Plate cells at low density to isolate single clones.

substeps.instruction: Coat 3 wells of a 6-well plate with 1mL Matrigel (supplemented with RGD fragment).
Wash with 1-2mL PBS per well.
Add 1mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Collect cells in 5mL DMEM/F12 and transfer to a 15mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 750-800rpm for 3 minutes.
Resuspend cells in mTesR1 supplemented with 5uM Rock Inhibitor.
Plate several dilutions of cells over the three wells (typically 25ul, 50ul, and 75ul in 2mLs of mTesR1).
Freeze remaining cells by adding an equal volume of 2x iPSC Freezing Media (20% DMSO in FBS).
Incubate at 37°C overnight.

steps.title: Pick and Expand Clones
steps.instruction: Pick isolated clones into 96-well plates for expansion.

substeps.instruction: Wait approximately 1 week for clones to proliferate to a pickable size.
Coat a 96-well plate with 50ul Matrigel per well and incubate at 37°C for one hour.
Aspirate Matrigel and replace with 50ul mTesR1 + 10uM Rock Inhibitor.
Using a p20, pick individual clones into unique wells using a new tip for each clone.
Incubate at 37°C overnight.

steps.title: Split 96-Well Plates for gDNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Split clones (between 40-80% confluence) to obtain cells for DNA extraction and continued culture/freezing.

substeps.instruction: Coat a new 96-well plate with 50uL Matrigel per well and incubate at 37°C for one hour.
Aspirate Matrigel from the expansion plate and add 50uL mTesR1 + 10uM Rock Inhibitor to appropriate wells.
Wash with 200uL PBS and aspirate.
Add 25uL of 0.05% Trypsin and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes; verify detachment via microscope.
Add 50uL FBS and tap to mix.

For continuing culture: Transfer 50uL to a 96-well PCR plate (for gDNA) and transfer remaining cells (~30uL) to the new Matrigel-coated 96-well plate containing mTesR1. Perform daily media changes after 24 hours.

For freezing down: Wash with 200uL PBS, add 25uL 0.05% Trypsin (5 min at 37°C), add 45uL mTesR1 and tap to mix. Transfer 15uL to a 96-well PCR plate (for gDNA) and add 50uL 2X Freezing Media (20% DMSO in FBS) to the cell plate. Wrap in parafilm, label, and store in a Styrofoam box at -80°C for up to 4 months.

steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract gDNA from the 96-well PCR plates.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96-well PCR plate at 3800 rpm for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Optional: Transfer supernatant to new PCR plates and store at -20°C.
Add 50uL QuickExtract DNA Solution (Epicentre Technologies QE09050) to the cell pellet.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate in thermocycler at 65°C for 6 minutes.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate in thermocycler at 98°C for 2 minutes.
Store the plate at -20°C.

steps.title: Screen Clones via PCR and Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Perform PCR and run a 2% agarose gel to identify edited clones.

substeps.instruction: Set up PCR using primers designed to amplify a 300-400bp region.
Cast a 2% agarose gel: Microwave Agarose and TBE until dissolved, add Ethidium Bromide, pour into casting tray with combs.
Run the gel at 150 volts for 90 minutes (check at 60 minutes).
Image the gel using a Syngene Imager and save multiple images.

steps.title: Perform Restriction Digest
steps.instruction: Use restriction enzymes to confirm the presence of the mutation/correction.

substeps.instruction: Identify the appropriate enzyme for the cell line/mutation.
Incubate the reaction in a thermocycler at the enzyme's specific temperature (e.g., 37°C, 42°C, 25°C) for 2-3 hours.
Run the resulting products on a 2% agarose gel at 150V for 90 minutes and image via Syngene Imager.
Analyze banding patterns to select potentially edited clones.

steps.title: Confirm Genotype via Sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform final validation of selected clones through sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Perform PCR on gDNA using the TouchDown Protocol (50μL reaction).
Run 15μL of each sample on a 2% gel at 150V for 90 minutes to confirm PCR product.
Using Eurofins prelabeled tubes, send one tube with a Forward primer and one tube with a Reverse primer for each sample.
Document barcode numbers and tube positions.

steps.title: Recover and Expand Confirmed Clones
steps.instruction: Thaw and expand the confirmed clones from the 96-well plate into 24-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Coat a 24-well plate with 250-300ul Matrigel per well and incubate at 37°C for one hour.
Thaw the 96-well plate at 37°C for 15-20 minutes.
Option A: Transfer cells to a 1.7mL tube, spin off freezing media, and plate in a fresh plate.
Option B: Transfer cells to a 1.7mL tube, dilute 1:5 (final volume 500uL) in mTesR1, and plate in the 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C overnight.

steps.title: Scale Up and Final Cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Expand confirmed clones and freeze them down for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Coat a 24-well plate with 250-300μL Matrigel for 1 hour.
Wash with 200-500μL PBS and aspirate.
Add 25μL 0.05% trypsin and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Prepare a new plate by adding 400μL mTesR1 + 10μM Rock Inhibitor to each well.
Add 75μL Complete Media (DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS) to the 96-well plate and tap to mix.
Transfer cells to the mTesR1 + Rock Inhibitor plate and incubate overnight at 37°C.
Add Accutase (Gibbco A11105-01) directly to cells and incubate at 37°C for 3-4 minutes.
Add DMEM/F12 directly to cells; use a cell scraper if cells remain attached.
Collect cells in a conical tube, adding 2-5mL DMEM/F12 to the dish to ensure full recovery.
Centrifuge at 750rpm for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend cell pellet with mTesR1 (No Rock Inhibitor).
Add 1/2 total volume of mTesR1 (assuming 1mL per cryovial) and pipet 1-2 times.
Add an equal volume of cold 2x Freezing Media (20% DMSO, FBS) and pipet once.
Transfer 1mL suspension to labeled cryovials.
Freeze at -80°C in foam racks for 48-72 hours, then transfer to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Characterization and Final Storage
steps.instruction: Perform quality control (Karyotype, gDNA, RNA, ICC) and freeze remaining stock.

substeps.instruction: Coat T25 flask, chamber slide, and plates with Matrigel 1 hour prior to passaging.
Wash with 1mL PBS and add 1mL Accutase per well of a 6-well plate; incubate at 37°C for 3-4 minutes.
Collect cells from 2 wells (3mL DMEM/F12 per well) into conical tube A and 4 wells (3mL DMEM/F12 per well) into conical tube B.
Centrifuge at 750rpm for 3 minutes.
From tube A (resuspended in 2mL mTesR1):
- Karyotype: Add 500μL cells to T25 flask with 2mL mTesR1.
- gDNA pellet: Spin 500μL cells at max speed for 15s, aspirate media, store at -80°C.
- RNA pellet: Spin 900μL cells at max speed for 15s, aspirate media, store at -80°C.
- ICC: Dilute 100μL cells in 750μL mTesR1; plate 200μL per well in 4 wells of a chamber slide.
From tube B: Resuspend in 4mL mTesR1 and 4mL 2x Freezing Media; add 1mL suspension to each cryovial and freeze.
